quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite press release: Expansion of Production Capacity for Advanced Semiconductor (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sumitomo Bakelite will add production lines for SUMIKON EME mold underfill (MUF) materials and compression-molding granules for advanced semiconductor packages at Sumitomo Bakelite (Suzhou) (expanding the new plant completed in 2024; production scheduled to begin in fiscal 2030) and Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore (inside the existing plant; production scheduled to begin at the end of fiscal 2028). After the expansion the company expects MUF capacity to roughly double and compression-molding granule capacity to roughly triple from current levels; the planned acquisition of Kyocera's chemical business at the end of October adds Kyocera's MUF and granule capacity. The company cites rapidly growing demand for advanced semiconductors for generative AI and communications satellites, particularly in China and Southeast Asia.
quarterly_data.figure: MUF capacity approximately double; compression-molding granule capacity approximately triple; Singapore production end of fiscal 2028; Suzhou production fiscal 2030
